reviews.review_description:
HYPERFLUX feels like a love letter to the legendary F-Zero series, and what a lovely tribute it is! Simple geometric lines, neon lights, synthwave aesthetics, and ridiculously fast racing. Even the soundtrack, with its 8-bit and 16-bit vibes, takes you straight back to the golden days of arcade gaming.

HYPERFLUX is a fast-paced arcade anti-gravity racer that knows exactly what it wants to deliver: speed, adrenaline, and pure racing fun.

With 11 tracks available, there's plenty of racing to enjoy. You'll also need to upgrade and improve your vehicle as you progress, allowing you to compete at increasingly challenging levels and push your racing skills further.

The gameplay is fast, responsive, and works really well in VR. It's one of those games where the combination of visuals, music, and speed creates an enjoyable arcade experience that keeps you coming back for another race.

Still in Early Access, so expect further improvements and hopefully plenty of new content along the way. The foundations are already solid, and I'm looking forward to seeing how far the developers can take this one.

If you grew up loving F-Zero, futuristic racing, or simply enjoy fast arcade games with a strong retro aesthetic, HYPERFLUX deserves a place in your VR library.

So, what are you waiting for? Strap in, hit the accelerator, and enjoy the ride! Highly recommended! 🚀
